headline: How to Summon Obelisk in Duel Links
title: How to Summon Obelisk the Tormentor in Duel Links | Every Way | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: How do you summon Obelisk the Tormentor in Duel Links? Here are the ways, and the catches. Way one: Tribute three monsters, your whole field in Duel Links. The Normal Summon cannot be negated, and nothing can be activated when it lands. Way two: Kaiba's Skill Memories of a Pharoah. From turn three you draw Obelisk, and one Blue-Eyes White Dragon counts as three Tributes. The catch: if you Tribute only one Blue-Eyes, Obelisk is sent to the Graveyard at the end of the turn, so use its field wipe right away. Way three: Ra's Disciple. One summon brings up to two more, and next turn all three go into Obelisk. Egyptian God Slime does the same job alone, because it counts as three Tributes. Way four: Monster Reborn. A Special Summoned Obelisk is sent to the Graveyard in the End Phase, so attack the same turn. Which way do you use? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Only 1 Blue-Eyes = gone at end of turn
